A news anchor introduces a segment on electric vehicles, with a graphic overlay showing a car plugged into a charger. The scene then transitions to a live demonstration at an auto show, where a man and a woman examine the open hood of a light green Kia electric car, followed by a close-up of a hand plugging the vehicle into a charging station, illustrating the practical use of EVs.

A news segment showcases a light green Kia EV being charged at an indoor exhibition. A person plugs in the charging cable, and the vehicle is shown connected to a charging station. The scene transitions to an interview with Yoo, Dong-kun from the Korea Environment Corporation, who discusses the establishment of an electric vehicle charging system, noting a current capacity for 500 vehicles and plans to expand.

A representative from the Korea Environment Corporation, Yoo, Dong-kun, is interviewed at an exhibition about Korea's expanding electric vehicle charging infrastructure. He explains that last year, a system was established to serve up to 500 EVs, and this year, a new system with a capacity for 2,600 vehicles is planned. He emphasizes that building this infrastructure will encourage more electric cars on the road, directly contributing to reduced carbon emissions and improved air quality
